ValidationRule.description: Forces documentation of what happened on referral close. Outcomes feed funder reporting.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Closed - Success"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Closed - Unable to Connect")), ISBLANK(Outcome__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When closing a referral (Closed - Success or Closed - Unable to Connect), please document the Outcome.
